blocks.text:
After breakfast, you will go snorkelling in the Rio da Prata.

The tour begins in a nature reserve. Participants are provided with wetsuits and masks.

The float down the clear river starts at the Olho d'Água spring. Underwater, you can see plants and fish, including piraputanga and pacus.

If you prefer, part of the route can be covered by boat.

The next activity is tubing down a mountain river on specially designed inflatable inner tubes.

Overnight in Bonito. Breakfast and lunch are included.

**Anhumas**

Optional

Only 2 groups of 8 people can take this tour each day.

blocks.text:
After breakfast, transfer to the airport and fly from Campo Grande to Rio de Janeiro.

From Rio, you will continue to Búzios. On arrival, check in to your hotel.

Búzios has grown from a fishing village into a popular resort. It has sandy beaches, clear water, green hills and plenty of opportunities for water activities.

You can go surfing or diving, paddle a kayak, hire a buggy to explore the town and beaches, or take a boat trip.

The centre has restaurants, bars and souvenir shops.
